interface.shortDescription: See what actually happened at runtime.
interface.longDescription: Lensflare is a local-first observability workspace. With this plugin, Codex can query the logs, spans, and traces collected by the Lensflare desktop app on 127.0.0.1:43110 — no cloud, no auth, no data egress. Ask 'what errors are in my dev dataset?' or paste a trace id and Codex will pull the full span tree, error summary, and timings.
defaultPrompt: What errors happened in my dev dataset in the last hour?
Show me the slowest spans where serviceName = "api" in Lensflare.
Pull trace 7c1e... from Lensflare and tell me where it failed.
